---
name: flightcourse-website
description: User's aviation education website FlightCourse — branding, tech stack, features, and monetization plan
sources: [chat]
aliases: [FlightCourse, FlightPath Academy, flight path]
---

- [stated] building a website to teach people about flying and aviation topics
- [stated] previous name/branding was "FlightPath Academy" (had a navy badge logo with a compass-style icon)
- [stated] settled on new name "FlightCourse" for the site (intended URL flightcourse.com)
- [stated] wants a logo in a badge/emblem style (icon + wordmark) rather than a plain wordmark-only design
- [stated] disliked a paper-airplane icon concept, a compass/heading-dial icon concept, and a "C" ring with gold dot concept as too generic or unoriginal
- [stated] wants the logo icon to be simple but very original/creative, not something other brands already use
- [stated] chose "ascending course mark" as the logo direction, and wants it developed further with a waypoint/compass-inspired creative twist
- [stated] site is built and running, currently focused on polish + monetization
- [stated] tech stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui, @react-three/fiber + drei, Framer Motion, Zustand with localStorage persistence, Prisma + SQLite (not actively used yet)
- [stated] site teaches total beginners to fly in flight simulators (MSFS, X-Plane) via 16 modules, built around the Cessna 172
- [stated] existing features: animated home page with 3D Cessna 172 GLB model and numbered pins, sectional-chart-style Learning Path with 16 waypoint nodes, module pages with quizzes/XP/badges, Cockpit Explorer with animated SVG instruments, 76-term Glossary, 5 interactive C172 checklists, Setup Guide for 4 sim platforms, Progress Dashboard with badges and certificate generator, FAQ, dark/light mode
- [stated] wants a hologram/blueprint-style texture look applied to the 3D Cessna 172 model
- [stated] brand colors: deep navy #0B1D3A, sky blue #3E92CC, horizon gold #F2B134
- [stated] design philosophy: cockpit-night aesthetic, gold used as a single accent, 8-point spacing grid, spring physics for interactive motion, ease-out-expo for reveals, restraint over decoration, aviation-motif details (VOR symbols, sectional chart textures, instrument bezels, monospace numerics)
- [stated] monetization plan (zero budget): Phase 1 free launch on Vercel with Amazon affiliate links + Ko-fi tip jar; Phase 2 Gumroad paid certificates ($9.99) + more affiliate links; Phase 3 mini-games (landing flare trainer, radio call builder, traffic pattern trainer) with first 5 plays free then $4.99 unlimited; Phase 4 freemium modules (1-5 free, 6-16 email-gated) plus flight school licensing
- [stated] current priorities: polish remaining visuals to premium quality, finish rebrand to FlightCourse, build mini-games as separate components, deploy to Vercel free tier, set up affiliate links + tip jar
- [stated] feels the current zero-budget monetization plan is too small/underwhelming and wants a much bigger approach to actually make real money from the project
- [stated] next planned step is working through the rebrand and deploy process (already in progress)
